QHEFermionsCorrelation, version 0.01

Usage: QHEFermionsCorrelation [options] 

Options:

system options:
    -p, --nbr-particles : number of particles (override autodetection from input file name if non zero) (default value = 0)
    -l, --lzmax : twice the maximum momentum for a single particle (override autodetection from input file name if non zero) (default value = 0)
    -z, --total-lz : twice the total momentum projection for the system (override autodetection from input file name if greater or equal to zero) (default value = 0)
    -s, --total-sz : twice the z component of the total spin of the system (default value = 0)
    -i, --total-isosz : twice the z component of the total isospin (i.e valley SU(2) degeneracy) of the system (default value = 0)
    --use-entanglement : use a define value for the spin-isopsin entanglement of the system
    -e, --total-entanglement : twice the projection of the total spin-isopsin entanglement of the system (default value = 0)
    --landau-level : index of the Landau level (0 being the LLL) (default value = 0)
    --state : name of the file containing the eigenstate
    -n, --nbr-points : number of point to evaluate (default value = 1000)
    -r, --radians : set units to radians instead of magnetic lengths
    -c, --chord : use chord distance instead of distance on the sphere

output options:
    -o, --output-file : use this file name instead of the one that can be deduced from the input file name (replacing the vec extension with rhorho extension

    --processors : number of processors to use in SMP mode (default value = 2)

misc options:
